items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

ctx.x: But before that you got into the Merv Griffin?

Yeah. I joined Merv in about ‘65. I left Woody in the World Series ‘64. Cardinals- Yankees, Reno, Nevada, ‘64. I watched the first two games there, then took a day off, flew back to New York and caught the next three games, and I bet on the Cardinals, and they won it that year, they did, they won it.
